description: This file provides compatibility wrappers around the 'open' system call, including retry logic for interrupted calls and support for the O_CLOEXEC flag, ensuring portability across different environments.

methods.name: int git_open_with_retry(const char * path,int flags,...)
methods.description: Opens a file with a retry mechanism for EINTR errors, optionally supporting the O_CREAT flag with a specified mode.

methods.name: int git_open_cloexec(const char * name,int flags)
methods.description: Opens a file with the O_CLOEXEC flag, falling back if unsupported, and includes logic to add the flag using fcntl if necessary.
